title: We are building NOPOTIONS, which combines traditional roleplaying system with an AI narrator
author: fluffy_the_sixth
selftext:
We have a custom engine for utilizing an AI game master to orchestrate gameplay within a premade world, with RPG systems like classic RPGs (e.g. Baldur's Gate).

The goal is to provide player freedom but still maintain the feeling of impactful consequences within the rules of the game world.

We are currently focusing on creating a solid single-player campaign set in an open-world with a persistent map. It is still in development but you can check us out at [nopotions.com](https://www.nopotions.com)

comments.author: OwO-animals
comments.body: That's actually pretty cool. My biggest gripe with stuff like AI dungeon is that it's boring and poorly designed overal. Of course same can be replicated by just having a good alghoritm and things that can combine and emerge. Unfortunately, no one does that and AI sort of does it, but not as good, still better than nothing.

replies.author: fluffy_the_sixth
replies.body:
Thanks! I agree completely, we are trying to make the experience more engaging by adding more class RPG systems like skill check, progression and loot.  
  
And we are also pre-making quests, events and NPCs to serve as guidelines for the AI to enhance upon instead of relying completely on LLM.

comments.author: IncorrectAddress
comments.body: Looks like a good start, nice visual queues, looks like you captured old school tabletop RPG's, don't for get to try and add something unique to it, and not only rely on old systems in a new look.

replies.author: fluffy_the_sixth
replies.body:
Glad you liked it! While staying faithful to classic RPGs, we are adding our own custom blend of systems to make sure the gameplay feels fresh and robust.

We have a unique narrative system where our characters talk to each other both in the background and during gameplay, to make the world feel alive and lived in.

comments.author: Plenty_Branch_516
comments.body: Hope it has a mobile client at some point. For some reason I can't see myself playing this on desktop, but would love it as a distraction when I'm out and about.

replies.author: fluffy_the_sixth
replies.body:
We do! We are working on both the desktop and mobile client so you will be able to play across platforms with synced progression. 

We just made a post and would love to hear your feedback on our mobile layout: https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1lq4o1h/what_do_you_think_of_the_mobile_ui_of_our_ai_rpg/
